name: carrom
description: Cross-platform multiplayer Carrom for web and mobile. Skill-based entertainment with virtual in-game coins only.

scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@carrom/api && npm run build --workspace=@carrom/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@carrom/api && npm run test --workspace=@carrom/web
scripts.dev:all: npm run docker:up && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web dev:admin
